decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith, (Plans A0501023, 033, 100 and Isleworth-00-mech-01, Design and Access Statement and specification data for outdoor units, received 21/1/11) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The noise level emitted from the two proposed Daikin condenser units should not be audible when assessed from the closest noise sensitive receptor.  The noise level emitted from the proposed "Daikin" condenser units, shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level (LAeq), when measured from the nearest noise sensitive receptor, over any period when the condenser units are operating.
Condition : 4 - The air conditioning shall not be in operation between the hours of 5pm-9am.
description: Installation of external air conditioning plant on the rear elevation of premises.
